price_format: Decimal strings. Absolute prices are authoritative at runtime (R3.2). Multipliers are stored for the ratio test only.
unverified_policy: An entry or field that is not stated on an official page above has verified false. A verified false entry, and a verified false modifier, MUST NOT produce dollars. Tokens are still reported and counted as unpriced (R3.3, R3.4, R3.9).

batch.note: Documented, but no per-model absolute batch price rows are stored. A batch response is unpriced_modifier under R3.4 until such rows exist.

geo_us.note: Per model flag in each entry. A1 states the 1.1x multiplier for Claude 4.6 and later models, on all token categories including cache writes and reads, and says it stacks with fast mode and caching.

fast_with_geo_us.note: A1 states that the data residency multiplier applies on top of fast mode pricing and that it covers input, output, cache writes and cache reads. A fast response with inference_geo us is priced at the fast row of the model times the geo multiplier (C32) where the model's geo_us applies.

openai_regional_endpoint.note: Regional and FedRAMP endpoints add 10 percent. Not observable in logs, so not applied (R3.4 assumption no_regional_surcharge_assumed).

openai_service_tier.note: O1 lists Fast and Ultrafast prices above the Standard prices for the same model (for example gpt-6.1-sol Fast is twice the Standard price, Ultrafast six times), and CX1 describes Standard, Fast and Ultrafast speed options. The tier of a response is not retained in or derivable from the logs (Q9), so a Codex response gets no dollars with reason modifier_unverified (R3.4). No Standard tier is assumed and no tier rows are stored except the existing gpt-5.3-codex fast row.

openai_long_context.note: Priced only where the entry's long_context object has verified true for its prices and scope request with scope_verified true (R3.10, R3.11). A session or unknown scope gives no dollars at any input size.
